title: HR Coordinator (Construction / FM)
company: Ernest Gordon Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Coordinator (Construction / FM)
30,000 - 35,000 DOE + Pension Scheme + Professional Development + Growth Potential + Salary Progression + Company Benefits
Bolton
Are you an HR coordinator with a background in the building services or construction industries, looking to join a market-leading construction company that offers professional development and a supportive working environment?
Would you like to work for a genuinely friendly and supportive team where the business is growing month by month and year by year?
On offer is an HR Coordinator role that will be responsible for coordinating the day-to-day delivery of HR services across the business, ensuring that people processes are efficient, compliant, and aligned with the company's values and business objectives.
The role provides operational support across the entire employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to employee development and offboarding. The HR Coordinator will work closely with managers to ensure consistent application of HR policies and procedures, maintain accurate employee records, support employee engagement initiatives, and contribute to the continuous improvement of HR systems and processes.
This company is a fast-growing building maintenance provider, carrying out refurbishments and refits for major clients across the UK, including national racecourses, commercial shops, and sports stadiums.
The Role:
- Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities, including advertising vacancies, liaising with recruitment agencies, arranging interviews, and communicating with candidates
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, and onboarding documentation
- Coordinate pre-employment checks, including right-to-work verification and reference requests
- Plan and deliver induction programmes for new employees
- Ensure all new starter information is accurately recorded within HR systems

The Person:
- CIPD Level 3 qualification (or working towards)

If you are interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV
Reference Number: BBBH26113 A
We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitable candidates. The salary advertised is a guideline for this position. The offered remuneration will be dependent on the extent of your experience, qualifications, and skill set.
Ernest Gordon Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job, you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at our website.

title: Customer Service Advisor - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 05/10/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Inventory Administrator
description:
Are you a highly organised administrator with excellent attention to detail and a passion for keeping operations running smoothly? If you're looking for a varied role where you can make a real impact within a growing business, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

About the Company

Our client is a well-established and growing service-led organisation supporting customers across the UK. Operating within a fast-paced technical environment, they deliver a range of operational and field-based services and are recognised for their commitment to quality, customer service and continuous improvement. Due to ongoing growth, they are looking to strengthen their head office team with the addition of an Inventory Administrator.

About the Role

This is a varied administrative position that combines inventory management, customer support and operational coordination. Working closely with engineers, remote locations and internal teams, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate stock records, supporting day-to-day operations, and ensuring inventory processes are effectively managed.

Benefits
- Starting salary of £26,500
- Full-time, Mon-Fri
- 28 days holidays inclusive of bank holidays
- Company Pension
- Free car parking
- Regular social events
- Opportunity to join a growing and established business
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Career development and progression opportunities

Key Responsibilities
- Process and maintain accurate data across internal software systems
- Track and record all inbound and outbound stock movements
- Monitor, manage and report stock levels across engineers and remote depots
- Provide customer support via telephone and email
- Order and manage inventory, including spare parts and consumables
- Conduct regular stock checks and support inventory audits
- Produce and maintain administrative documentation and correspondence
- Assist with project coordination, resource allocation and engineer scheduling
- Ensure all records are maintained accurately and efficiently

Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous administration experience with a strong focus on accuracy and attention to detail
- Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Confident communicator with a professional telephone manner
- Able to learn new systems and adapt to changing priorities
- Positive, proactive approach and ability to work effectively within a team

Desirable Skills
- Experience within customer service or customer support
- Previous experience in a technical, engineering or maintenance environment
- Knowledge of inventory management systems, such as Zoho Inventory
- Familiarity with Health & Safety documentation, including RAMS

If you're a detail-oriented administrator looking for a varied role within a growing business, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to take the next step in your career and become part of a supportive team where your organisational skills and initiative will make a real difference.

title: Complaints Handler
description:
Complaints Handler. Bolton (BL2) £27,500. 25 days hol + BH's. 1 day per week WFH (12 month FTC )

A market leader in their sector, our client is looking for an experienced Complaints Handler to join the customer service department and be dedicated to taking ownership of issues and complaints and seeing them through to resolution. Duties will include;
- Taking details of the issue/complaint over the phone or via email, acknowledging receipt with the customer and talking them through the next steps
- Liaising with other departments, suppliers and other contractors involved to investigate the complaint
- Some queries will be quicker to resolve than others and may involve a simple refund of delivery charges. Others may be more complex and involve the return of faulty goods back to the manufacturer for further investigation which will take longer
- Keeping the customer updated at all stages of their case

To be successful, you will have a strong background in customer service and previous experience of handling complaints through to resolution. You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills and have the ability to remain calm and professional at all times.

Please forward your CV for immediate consideration, I look forward to hearing from you.

Please note that due to the high volume of applications we receive, only those successfully shortlisted for the role will be personally contacted.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook for updates, recruitment information, new vacancies and more!

title: Third Party Claims Handler
description:
Third Party Claims Handler

Location: Bolton
Salary: From £24,479 - £35,000 DOE
Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Are you an experienced Motor Claims Handler with experience handling Third Party Vehicle Damage, Property Damage or Credit Hire claims?

We are currently recruiting for a Third Party Claims Handler to join a well-established and reputable insurance business based in Bolton.

Due to continued growth and internal promotions, this is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious claims professional looking to develop their career within a supportive and forward-thinking organisation.

The Role

As a Third Party Claims Handler, you will manage a portfolio of Third Party Vehicle Damage and Property Damage claims, ensuring cases are handled efficiently while delivering an excellent level of service to all parties involved.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing a portfolio of Third Party Motor and Property Damage claims.
- Prioritising your own workload and managing claims efficiently.
- Investigating claims and establishing liability.
- Handling more complex cases, including Liability and High Value claims.
- Liaising with solicitors, insurers, accident management companies and other third parties.
- Identifying and referring potentially fraudulent activity.
- Working closely with internal departments throughout the claims process.
- Delivering a consistently high level of customer service.

About You

We are looking for someone with previous experience within Motor Claims, Third Party Claims or Credit Hire who is looking for their next career opportunity.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience handling Third Party Motor claims and/or Credit Hire claims.
- Strong customer service and communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to build effective relationships with customers and third parties.
- Strong organisational and computer skills.
- The ability to manage and prioritise a busy workload.
- A CII qualification, or the willingness to work towards this.
- GCSE English and Maths at Grade C/4 or above, or equivalent.

Candidates with 2+ years of Motor Claims experience may be considered for the higher end of the salary range.

What's in it for you?

Alongside a competitive salary, you will receive an excellent benefits package, including:
- Increased holiday allowance with length of service.
- Your birthday off.
- Half-day off for seasonal shopping.
- Holiday sell scheme.
- Contributory pension scheme.
- Support with industry-relevant qualifications, including CII.
- Discounted sports and social activities.
- Free on-site parking.
- Casual dress code and branded clothing allocation.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- Cash bonuses for going above and beyond.
- Trained Mental Health and First Aid staff on-site.
- Flexible working patterns available.
- Sociable Monday-Friday working hours.
- And much more!

If you're an experienced Motor Claims or Third Party Claims Handler looking for a new opportunity with genuine career progression and development, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to be considered.

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Service Coordinator Wigan (Office Based role) Engineering Permanent (Competitive Salary)

Summary
My client are seeking a proactive Service Coordinator to support the daily operations of their Service Department. This role involves working closely with Mechanical, Electrical, and Fire & Security service teams to coordinate service activities Planned and Reactive, manage documentation, schedule engineers, and ensure customers receive a professional and efficient service.

The position requires excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail, and a customer-focused approach to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Key responsibilities include handling customer enquiries, processing service requests, maintaining certification records, issuing reports and certificates, and liaising with engineers, customers, and subcontractors to ensure timely and accurate service delivery.
Key Responsibilities
- Manage day-to-day administrative tasks within the Service Department
- Handle incoming telephone calls and respond to customer enquiries
- Process service requests and raise jobs accurately within the job management system
- Schedule and coordinate service appointments for engineers
- Review engineers reports for accuracy before issuing to customers
- Maintain certification records and ensure proper documentation storage
- Issue service reports and certificates promptly
- Chase outstanding information from engineers, customers, and subcontractors
- Upload material costs and maintain accurate job records
- Provide service updates and communicate effectively with customers

Skills
- Previous experience in an administrative or customer service role
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
- Experience using job management systems or CRM software

description: An exciting opportunity has arisen within the Wigan Admin Teams for a Team Administrator. If you have a flexible approach and the ability to adapt to changing priorities, this will be an excellent opportunity to develop your skills. Please note - This role is not eligible for sponsorship unless you meet criteria by temporary exemption from current changes to immigration rules put in force on 22/07/2025. Separate provisions are applied to workers who have been sponsored and held continuously Skilled Worker visa since prior to 04/04/2024. The Team Administrator will be responsible for providing a comprehensive and confidential administrative support to the Referral and Assessment Team. The post holder will provide an administrative function to the managers, minute taking of meetings, typing of letters, filing, diary management and other general administrative duties. title: Clerical Officer
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for admin and clerical staff to join the Neurology Long Term Conditions and Stroke Community Therapy teams. We have opportunities available to work within our Neurology Long Term Conditions and Neurotherapy and Stroke Therapy Services . The role will be to provide administrative support to services and part and full time hours would be considered.Candidates must be highly motivated and able to multi-task in a busy administration office. Good IT skills and attention to detail are also a must; we aim to deliver a high standard of service to our patients and medical team. If casenotes are not in main storage areas use tracking system to locate and request where necessary. Action any telephone request from colleagues, patients, outside agencies. Update LE2.2 tracking system to show location and current status of casenotes in relation to document management. Filing confidential information away into the casenotes and retrieving casenotes for consultants, secretaries or nurses. Registering of referrals and booking appointments on the Trust systems Daily checking of the Envoy system to ensure cancellation slots are fully utilised. title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic GP Surgery Receptionist to join our busy and friendly practice team. The successful candidate will work Monday to Friday, 2:30pm to 6:30pm , and should be flexible and adaptable to the needs of the practice. As a key member of our reception team, you will be the first point of contact for patients, both face-to-face and over the telephone. You will provide a welcoming, professional and compassionate service while helping to ensure that patients receive timely and appropriate care. Previous experience working within a GP practice or general practice environment is essential, along with confidence using EMIS Web. Welcoming patients and visitors in a professional and compassionate manner. Handling telephone calls and patient queries efficiently, ensuring appropriate signposting. Booking, amending, and cancelling appointments via EMIS Web. Processing patient registrations, repeat prescription requests, and clinical correspondence. Scanning and accurately registering clinical documents onto patient records. Assisting with monitoring and recording data for QOF (Quality and Outcomes Framework) KPIs. Referring patients to the relevant specialties or external services as directed. Supporting clinicians and the wider team with administrative tasks. Ensuring confidentiality and compliance with NHS policies, GDPR, and safeguarding procedures. Greet and assist patients and visitors in a polite, professional, and compassionate manner. Answer and manage incoming telephone calls, dealing with patient queries and signposting appropriately. Book, amend, and cancel patient appointments using the practice clinical system (e.g., EMIS Web). Process new patient registrations, temporary residents, and patient record updates. Manage repeat prescription requests in line with practice protocols. Handle patient correspondence, referrals, and medical reports. Ensure the reception area is tidy, organised, and welcoming at all times. Scan, code, and file clinical documents into patient records accurately. Assist with monitoring and inputting data for QOF (Quality and Outcomes Framework) and other performance indicators. Prepare and send patient referrals to secondary care and community services. Support the management of recalls, long-term condition reviews, and screening programmes. Carry out administrative support for clinicians, nurses, and the management team. Maintain confidentiality and adhere to GDPR and NHS information governance policies. Contribute to maintaining practice policies, procedures, and quality standards.
